Tests: crates/mimid-agent/tests/didwebvh_log.rs (revocation POSTed while running removes d2 without restarts; unchanged; another user's log and the older v1 refused 422 with reason and not applied; 400 malformed; 401 without token; file change taken), crates/mimid-agent-core/src/agent_didwebvh_tests.rs (fallback through a real hub, Commit failure injected under cfg(test): proposal accepted, bob commits, record = controller's v2), mimi-mls didwebvh_rogue.rs (real pending GCE from a plain OpenMLS member -> PendingGroupContextExtensions, Update proposal still built). Limits found: with a real pending GCE a mimid committer of the Update fails too (Open Issue 5), and another member's revocation Remove needs canKick (filed as follow-up). Feedback item 28.
